supersedes_for_new_checkpoints_only: tokenizer/artifacts/aila_nano.model (v1, 8192, English-only corpus) remains the production tokenizer for all existing 20M/50M checkpoints and is NOT replaced.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg PT literature (Machado de Assis, Alencar, Azevedo, Camoes, ...)
sources.note: 8 works, langid-verified Portuguese; classic/literary register (PT-BR + Os Lusiadas PT-PT).

compatibility: vocab_size=16384 != 8192, so this tokenizer is for FUTURE v2 checkpoints only. Existing checkpoints (vocab 8192) stay with aila_nano.model; validate_checkpoint_compatibility rejects a mismatch with a clear error.
